description: NLS-FI INSPIRE Maantieteelliset nimet Theme Dataset is a dataset listed in Paikkatietohakemisto, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by maanmittauslaitos.fi. NLS-FI INSPIRE Geographical Names Theme Dataset is a dataset depicting the Named Places and Geographical Names covering the whole of Finland. It contains the following INSPIRE feature types: NamedPlace The elements are updated weekly. Coverage: FI. The portal shows the English title as "NLS-FI INSPIRE Geographical Names Theme Dataset" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 4 download or service links in WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-paikkatietohakemisto.
